info.title: Rodrigo service contract
info.description: Signed Hub-to-Rodrigo contract. Workspace comes exclusively from verified Ed25519 assertions. Optional PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB owners commit document changes and event history together; Redis is a disposable cache; named S3-compatible stores hold immutable small objects. No cross-provider atomicity or automatic write retries. Absent providers fail closed. Hub data migration is separate from deploying Rodrigo.

get.description: Cursor is signed in the path. Last-Event-ID headers are rejected. SSE event document.changed has ID equal to revision and ChangeEvent JSON data. 1000 revisions retained per workspace/kind; pages of 64; max 32 streams per replica. Stream closes within assertion lifetime, at most 25 seconds; Hub reauthorizes and re-signs reconnects. At-least-once replay within retention, no server-side acknowledgements. stream.error with cursor_expired or dependency_unavailable terminates an already-open stream. No cross-kind ordering.

hubAssertion.description: iss=sorye-hub, aud=rodrigo, sub, workspaceId, scope, method, path, bodySha256, iat, exp <= iat+30, jti UUID. kid selects trusted public key. TLS required across VMs. Assertions are bearer credentials until expiration; jti is not a distributed replay lock.
